description.value: Blooming Spice Fish House is a Sichuan-style restaurant specialising in its signature 'boiling fish' — black fish slices doused tableside in two pounds of scorching hot oil loaded with chili and Sichuan peppercorns sourced directly from China. The dish follows a 30-year-old recipe, and the menu extends to cold jelly noodles, spicy frog, and dry-pot dishes. This is the chain's sole BC location, situated in a commercial complex in central Richmond.

address.value: 8368 Capstan Way, Unit 1318, Richmond, BC V6X4B6
